name: Predictive Input Buffer
description: Diagnostic revision for verifying iOS hooks. Input buffering, wave prediction, and Safe Mode enforcement are not active in this revision.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Master switch for the input assistance features. The current diagnostic revision does not alter gameplay.

buffer-stage.name: Input Buffer Stage
buffer-stage.description: 1 = 2 ticks, 2 = 4 ticks, 3 = 8 ticks, 4 = 16 ticks (all) / 8 ticks (wave), 5 = Off (raw input).

safe-mode.name: Safe Mode
safe-mode.description: ON: attempts where the mod changed your inputs do not save progress. OFF: progress saves normally even when the mod helped.

show-debug-overlay.name: Show Debug Overlay
show-debug-overlay.description: Show live iOS hook diagnostics in PlayLayer.
